name: Spanish Common Words Set 12
description: This is part of a larger set of common Spanish words, featuring additional frequently used vocabulary not included in previous sets.

cards.sentence: ¿Qué edad tienes?
cards.sentenceTranslation: How old are you?

cards.sentence: Necesito una bolsa para la compra.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a bag for shopping.

cards.sentence: Ponte la bufanda, hace frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put on your scarf, it's cold.

cards.sentence: Apriétate el cinturón de seguridad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Fasten your seatbelt.

cards.sentence: Se me ha caído un botón de la camisa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A button has fallen off my shirt.

cards.sentenceTranslation: My jacket's zipper is broken.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Let's go to the beach, don't forget the parasol.

cards.sentence: Lleva un paraguas por si llueve.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

cards.sentenceTranslation: The children play with a bucket and a shovel in the sand.

cards.sentenceTranslation: The teacher wrote with chalk on the blackboard.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I need an eraser to correct the mistake.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Use glue to stick the two pieces together.

cards.sentenceTranslation: He tied the box with a strong rope.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Pass me the screwdriver, please.

cards.sentenceTranslation: He cut the wood with an electric saw.

cards.sentenceTranslation: She is a very versatile actress.

cards.sentenceTranslation: The singer has a beautiful voice.

cards.sentenceTranslation: You must boil the vegetables until they are tender.
